tasks.name: Describe the benefits of using cloud services

concepts.name: Cloud computing: the basic idea
concepts.description: Cloud computing is the delivery of computing services over a network when you need them.

concepts.name: Shared responsibility: who secures what
concepts.description: In cloud computing, security and operations are split between the cloud provider and the customer.

concepts.name: Public, private, and hybrid cloud models
concepts.description: A cloud model describes where cloud resources run and who they are dedicated to.

concepts.name: Consumption-based cloud economics
concepts.description: A consumption-based model charges for cloud resources as you use them.

concepts.name: Consumption-based cloud economics
concepts.description: A consumption-based model charges for cloud resources as you use them.

concepts.name: Serverless: focus on code, not servers
concepts.description: Serverless computing lets you run application logic without provisioning or managing the servers that execute it.

concepts.name: High availability and scalability
concepts.description: High availability means designing a service to remain accessible despite failures.

concepts.name: High availability and scalability
concepts.description: High availability means designing a service to remain accessible despite failures.

concepts.name: Reliability and predictability
concepts.description: Reliability is the ability of a system to recover from failures and continue functioning as intended.

concepts.name: Reliability and predictability
concepts.description: Reliability is the ability of a system to recover from failures and continue functioning as intended.

concepts.name: Security and governance benefits
concepts.description: Cloud providers supply security capabilities and protect the underlying platform.

concepts.name: Security and governance benefits
concepts.description: Cloud providers supply security capabilities and protect the underlying platform.

concepts.name: Manageability in the cloud
concepts.description: Manageability is the ability to provision, configure, monitor, and control cloud resources with consistent tools and automation.

concepts.name: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)
concepts.description: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) provides fundamental cloud infrastructure such as virtual machines, networking, and storage.

concepts.name: Platform as a Service (PaaS)
concepts.description: Platform as a Service (PaaS) gives developers a managed platform for building and running applications.

concepts.name: Software as a Service (SaaS)
concepts.description: Software as a Service (SaaS) is a complete application delivered as a managed service.

concepts.name: Choose IaaS, PaaS, or SaaS
concepts.description: IaaS provides configurable infrastructure, PaaS provides a managed application platform, and SaaS provides a complete managed application.

questions.prompt: A team wants computing capacity it can provision over a network on demand instead of buying hardware first. Which concept is being described?
questions.explanation: Cloud computing delivers computing services over a network when they are needed, allowing resources to be provisioned without first buying and installing physical infrastructure.
hints: Look for on-demand computing delivered over a network.

questions.prompt: Place each responsibility with the party that normally owns it in a typical Azure IaaS virtual-machine scenario.
questions.explanation: In IaaS, Microsoft operates the physical cloud infrastructure, while the customer still manages the guest OS, applications, data, identities, and configuration.
hints: Ask whether the item is part of the physical cloud or the customer workload.

questions.prompt: A manufacturer must keep a legacy control system in its own datacenter but wants to use Azure for new analytics workloads. Which cloud model best describes this plan?
questions.explanation: Hybrid cloud connects or combines private/on-premises environments with public cloud services, which fits a requirement to keep some workloads local while using Azure for others.
hints: The key clue is that part of the environment must remain on-premises.

choice_feedback.b: Private cloud alone would not describe the new Azure analytics workload.
choice_feedback.c: Correct. Hybrid cloud combines an on-premises/private environment with public cloud services.

questions.prompt: Classify each spending example as capital expenditure (CapEx) or operational expenditure (OpEx).
questions.explanation: CapEx is an up-front investment in owned assets. Consumption-based cloud spending is typically ongoing OpEx that can change with usage.
hints: Up-front ownership points to CapEx; ongoing usage-based spending points to OpEx.

questions.prompt: A developer wants code to run when a file is uploaded and does not want to provision or manage servers. Which Azure compute approach best fits?
questions.explanation: Azure Functions is a serverless compute service designed for event-driven code. The provider manages the underlying servers even though servers still exist.
hints: Event-driven code with minimal server management is the clue.

source_refs.title: Study guide for Exam AZ-900: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals — skills measured as of July 20, 2026

error_codes.description: The selected choice is not the best answer.

choice_feedback.a: Correct. Azure Functions runs event-driven code while abstracting server provisioning and management.
choice_feedback.b: A virtual machine gives OS-level control, but the customer must manage the VM and is not the best fit for this serverless requirement.
choice_feedback.c: A managed web-app platform reduces OS management, but the file-triggered event-driven requirement points more directly to a function.
choice_feedback.d: SaaS is a complete hosted application; it is not a service for running the team’s event-driven code.

questions.prompt: Match each requirement to the cloud model that best fits.
questions.explanation: Public cloud emphasizes provider-operated shared infrastructure and elasticity, private cloud is dedicated to one organization, and hybrid cloud combines private/on-premises environments with public cloud services.
hints: Focus on where resources run and whether the organization must keep part of the environment outside public cloud.

questions.prompt: An organization wants centrally applied rules so new cloud resources follow approved standards. Which cloud benefit is most directly involved?
questions.explanation: Governance capabilities help organizations apply standards, track compliance, and keep resource configuration within approved rules.
hints: Look for standards and consistent rules across resources.

source_refs.title: Study guide for Exam AZ-900: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals — skills measured as of July 20, 2026
Describe the benefits of using cloud services — Microsoft Learn

error_codes.description: The selected choice is not the best answer.

choice_feedback.a: Correct. Governance is about applying standards, policies, and compliance rules consistently.
choice_feedback.b: Security is about protecting identities, data, applications, and infrastructure; the key clue here is organizational standards.
choice_feedback.c: Manageability concerns provisioning, monitoring, and controlling resources; centrally enforced standards are a governance clue.
choice_feedback.d: Predictability concerns anticipating cost or performance, not enforcing organizational rules.

questions.prompt: A cloud platform provides built-in identity, encryption, threat-protection, and security-management capabilities that a customer can configure for its workload. Which cloud benefit is most directly illustrated?
questions.explanation: Cloud providers supply security capabilities and protect the underlying platform, while customers still configure and use those controls according to the shared responsibility model.
hints: Built-in controls and platform protection point to the security benefit, not a transfer of all responsibility.

source_refs.title: Study guide for Exam AZ-900: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals — skills measured as of July 20, 2026

error_codes.description: The selected choice is not the best answer.

choice_feedback.a: Correct. Built-in identity, encryption, and threat-protection capabilities illustrate the cloud security benefit.
choice_feedback.b: Governance focuses on standards and compliance rather than the security capabilities listed in the prompt.
choice_feedback.c: Manageability is about operating and controlling resources efficiently; the prompt is specifically about protection capabilities.
choice_feedback.d: Reliability is about continuing to operate and recover from failures, not identity and threat protection.

questions.prompt: Which TWO examples demonstrate cloud manageability?
questions.explanation: Cloud manageability includes consistent tools, automation, templates, APIs, and centralized monitoring for provisioning and controlling resources.
hints: Choose actions that make provisioning or control more consistent and automated.
